scope.family_rule: Exact/rel32 OT44 clones together, OT2C clones together, shadow setter siblings together. OT44 and OT2C remain distinct variants; merging these as one parameterized family gives 27 primary families.

history_coverage.method: V2 documentation fetched first; live GET /openapi.json; authenticated opencode-cli.exe api get; session and message cursor pagination, 5/10/20 item pages; all analysis in Context Mode. No database access.
archive_limitations: 100% refers only to the three requested session trees and their available API message projections, not to all historical agents in the repository.
32 public tool records have metadata.truncated=true. Complete original tool payload coverage cannot be quantified.

Older September GLM generation artifacts are available, but their originating agent session trees are not identified by these three October trees. Model/provider diversity and original prompt independence are not established for those drafts.
No raw transcripts, reasoning text, secrets, authorization data or database copies exported. Older C artifacts are a separate artifact comparison cohort.
The archived C1/C6/C9/C10 session records were counted for tree coverage only; their mutable packs and current campaign session were not read or used as closed outcomes.

solo_October_control_plane.caveat: This is the October parent, not proof of the model of inherited September A/V or raw C generations.

fresh_Sol_roles.caveat: Final blind B/R and fresh A/V where present. Not every lot has every role; use cases.semantic_artifacts.

retained_B1_B4_B5_B6.caveat: No fresh generation or semantic review in these trees.

fresh_C_pair_read_route_check.scope: Native read routes checked in public history; tool code/live ASM acquisitions were also present. This is context independence, not independent model diversity.

impact_classes.4: Documentation/cosmetic precision without code behavior change
impact_classes.7: Portability/out-of-domain C contract issue, separately reported

definitions.substantial: Classes 1,2,3; counted by affected EA, not by bullet or generation. Bounds are observed lower bounds, not an exhaustive defect rate.
definitions.marginal_b: A valid correction first furnished by B that was not already in contemporary V or parent/R before B. R research is not credited to B.
definitions.raw_c_denominator: Twenty non-stub GLM-labeled A/B/C artifact sets plus two fresh independently contextualized Sol A/B sets; raw generators and semantic A/B are different objects.

semantic_A_substantial_issue_addressed_b.note: B3 ordering claim in A L6 is wrong despite V calling disagreements zero; V independently supplies correct order. B9 overvalidates historical C. This counts prose/validation claims, not newly emitted C bugs.

strict_B_novel_substantial_after_V.note: All cited substantive B corrections were already in V. Do not extend to the two no-V escalations or interpret as zero probability of benefit.

fresh_V_false_positive_confirmed.note: No confirmed rejected corrective claim found. Not an exhaustive truth certification.

semantic_R_correction_of_both_A_and_stri.note: Return-contract investigation and reservations are not false claims. J3 restoration wording is not a wrong detailed machine reconstruction.

raw_c_sets_with_proven_substantial_defec.note: Artifact comparison only. Not a GLM-versus-Sol model test, not a whole-repository error rate. Deferred order/alias and class7 issues not added to this numerator.

C_two_authors_share_same_wrong_claim_low.note: A/C wrong OT-base, A/B wrong list-head address, B/C wrong row advancement. Do not treat two-of-three as unanimous.

C_B_correct_component_missing_or_wrong_i.note: Useful complementary component, NOT marginal benefit versus an ASM reviewer and NOT an entirely correct B.

C_R_false_positive_at_least.note: Rejects correct &31 x86 SAR count normalization as invented. Separate from semantic V false positives and from valid-domain behavior rates.

residual_C_reload_fidelity_issue_after_s.note: R explicitly demands reloads, but committed C still caches actor and phase across callbacks. Conditional discrepancy; callee nonmutation not proved.

escalation_necessity.note: Protocol compliance is not causal evidence. No randomized/no-B control arm; R research and parent ASM checks confounded.

correction_evidence.corrector: B row-base component plus ASM reconciliation

observed_usage.caveat: Recorded zeros for OpenAI subscription sessions do not establish zero economic cost. Reasoning and output may overlap; do not sum token categories as disjoint. No provider rates invented. No wall-wait latency equated with reasoning. This is not cost per function.

recommendation.demonstrated: Raw C generations can make material ABI/memory errors even on 15-60 instruction functions. ASM adjudication is indispensable and agreement is not correctness. Fresh semantic V catches historical R errors without a second blind derivation bringing new fixes in the three observed paired post-V cases.
recommendation.not_demonstrated: Universal superiority of dual-gen+R, equivalence of 1+V and 2+1, a new safe size threshold, GLM-versus-Sol error rates or economic savings.
recommendation.candidate_policy_after_user_validation: Keep 1+P only <=80 + CERTAIN + genuine parent ASM gate; default semantic 1+V; consider adaptive 2+1 for unresolved actual disagreement/coverage/ABI failures rather than size alone. For C require one faithful reconstruction plus independent full ASM review; use blind dual generation adaptively for high ambiguity and failed review, rather than silently trusting a solo draft.
required_extra_gates: All return paths and register widths
Actual push words and grouped cleanup
Numeric stride and typed pointer arithmetic
Reloads and store order across callbacks
x86 masked shifts versus C undefined behavior, domain assumptions explicit
Separate code correction from comment/provenance correction
Propagate accepted correction to frozen deliverable and recheck actual diff
Clone equivalence gate and family-level counting
B blindness checked by observed read routes, not prompt alone
recommendation.pilot: Prospective paired blind pilot on frozen packs, one representative per family, all three size bins. Freeze A; V and blind B independently inspect unchanged sources; parent evaluates V-only fixes and then incremental B/R findings against ASM. Include clean <=80 controls, 81-200 cases and >200 high-ambiguity cases; record same-EA token fields, contamination/infrastructure retries and adjudicated novel material defects. No model ranking without matched tasks.
recommendation.uncertainty: Fractions and lower bounds only: 0/3 and 0/2 are too small and selected for reliable population intervals or blanket policy changes.

derivation_python:
import json
a=json.load(open('audit.json',encoding='utf-8'))
c=a['cases']; raw=[x for x in c if 'raw_c_substantial_defect' in x]
assert len(c)==33 and len({x['ea'] for x in c})==33
assert len({x['family'] for x in c})==28
assert [sum(x['instructions']<=80 for x in c),sum(80<x['instructions']<=200 for x in c),sum(x['instructions']>200 for x in c)]==[18,9,6]
assert len(raw)==22 and sum(x['raw_c_substantial_defect'] for x in raw)==12
assert len({x['family'] for x in raw})==17 and len({x['family'] for x in raw if x['raw_c_substantial_defect']})==9
v=[x for x in c if x.get('fresh_V')]; assert len(v)==8
assert sum(x['V_verdict']=='ACCEPTE' for x in v)==5
assert sum(x.get('A_substantial_issue_addressed_by_V',False) for x in v)==2
p=[x for x in v if 'strict_B_novel_substantial_after_V' in x]; assert len(p)==3 and sum(x['strict_B_novel_substantial_after_V'] for x in p)==0
u=a['observed_usage']['paired_semantic_post_V']
for role in ['V','B','R']: print(role,{k:sum(x[role][k] for x in u) for k in ['input','output','cache_read']})
h=a['history_coverage']; assert sum(x['messages'] for x in h['roots'])+h['children']['messages']==2180
print('audit invariants OK')
